name: Anesaki Amane
source:
A 3rd year student and student council president. Because she enjoys supporting others, Amane tends to take the initiative in student council activities that support the school's lively clubs.

She is very popular with both male and female students because of her dedication, good looks and nice personality.

On the other hand, rumors say that she is uncomfortable being around boys because she tends to run away from them.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/o-kanojo/]official website[/url].]
